Last updated: November 4, 2026 12:34 am 
 By 
 Aiman Maulana 
 Share 
 3 Min Read 
 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale is back with a full lineup of daily livestreams, celebrity appearances, and RM11 million in vouchers up for grabs – running from now until 12 November, the campaign centers heavily on Shopee Live, the platform’s built-in livestream shopping feature, with exclusive deals and limited-time vouchers tied directly to each broadcast.
 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale Livestream
 Shopee’s official livestream channel is hosting daily broadcasts from 1 to 11 November, featuring well-known Malaysian personalities. On 10 November from 8pm to 10pm, Dato’ Sri Aliff Syukri will be launching a new prayerwear and bag collection exclusively on Shopee Live, with a 10-item set box priced at RM129 available for a limited time.
 Also on 10 November, content creators Ruyuan and Jo from Picksbyquahs will be sharing curated picks across beauty, lifestyle, and home essentials from brands including Cuckoo, FAN BEAUTY, Jisulife, Iconic, Kiehl’s, and Lancome, with livestream-exclusive deals throughout the session.
 On 11 November from 3.30pm to 9pm, Khairul Aming will be hosting his first-ever livestream from a yacht. Earlier in the campaign, Ain Ramli and Shabina are live on 2 and 3 November featuring promotions from La Roche Posay, Medicube, and Torriden. Throughout the campaign from 1 to 11 November, viewers can claim 60% off daily livestream vouchers on their orders. Shoppers tuning in to the Shopee Mamak Lagi Murah Show from 2 to 6 November also stand a chance to win giveaway vouchers worth up to RM1,111.
 Shopee is expanding its VIP program benefits for the 11.11 period. Members will receive daily 30% off vouchers, free shipping discounts, and early access to Knockout Vouchers and Knockout Deals from 8 November onwards. Shopee VIP is also introducing RM1 Food Deals covering selected products from Mixue, McDonald’s, and Pizza Hut. First-time subscribers can sign up for a one-month free trial to access all these perks.
 For last-minute shoppers in Klang Valley, Shopee’s Buy Today, Get Today service offers one-hour delivery on groceries and household essentials via Instant Delivery. Starting 10 November, delivery fees on this service will be discounted by 50% from 10 to 11 November. A whole sandwich loaf is also available on Instant Mart for just 11 cents, available until 20 November.
 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale Features RM11 Million In Vouchers And Daily Livestreams With Malaysian Celebrities Running separately from 26 October to 12 November, the Kamatto Spend and Win campaign gives shoppers who spend a minimum of RM180 with Kamatto a chance to win a brand-new Proton Saga MC3 worth RM49,990. Participants can boost their chances by completing tasks via Shopee Mission to accumulate points.
